title: RecipeTin's No-Bake Choc Cheesecake
ingredients: Filling Choc: 200g 70% chocolate, 2 tbsp cocoa powder, 2.5 tbsp boiling water
Filling Dairy: 1 cup heavy cream, 500g softened cream cheese, 1 cup caster sugar, 1 tsp vanilla extract
Topping: 1 cup heavy cream, 1 tbsp caster sugar, 0.25 tsp vanilla, shaved chocolate
steps: Line an inverted 20cm springform pan with a buttered paper base and high side collars.
Blitz Oreos into fine crumbs, mix with melted butter, and press firmly into the pan base.
Melt 200g chocolate, bloom cocoa in hot water, whip 1 cup cream, and beat cream cheese with sugar.
Fold melted chocolate, bloomed cocoa, and whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture until smooth.
Pour into pan, chill 2 hours, top with hot cream-chocolate ganache, and set in fridge for 6+ hours.
Release from pan, pipe whipped cream swirls, top with shaved chocolate, and slice cold.
